authority.scope: post-formal measurement, semantic-label eligibility, responsibility attribution, and learnability start gates
preserves: the failure of all four V5.3 formal heads
all spent manifests, replies, judgments, and OOF predictions
supersedes_for_future_training_only: uncalibrated functional-use judgments as training evidence
quality uplift alone as a component opportunity label
UNKNOWN or missing execution/risk evidence being treated as OFF gold
the three-user development pilot as sufficient model-selection evidence

system_definition.context: deployment-visible current dialogue plus legal strictly-prior actual Rank-1 candidates
system_definition.action: one of the frozen 16 MP/MS/ME/RS combinations
system_definition.policy: the four-head PM followed by frozen joint projection
system_definition.executor: typed Step2 generator plus deterministic guard/fallback
system_definition.why_not_rl: an RL algorithm cannot repair ambiguous state, invalid rewards, missing raw execution traces, or mixed responsibility; it would optimize those errors

candidate_truth.question: Is the frozen actual Rank-1 candidate valid, about the right owner/time/event, currently applicable, nonredundant, and useful for this response?

pm_opportunity_truth.question: Assuming a valid candidate and correct functional execution, is requesting this component beneficial, harmful, or equivalent?

execution_truth.question: Did Step2 receive and functionally realize the requested resource with correct owner/time/boundary?

guard_truth.question: Was accepting or rejecting the raw Step2 response correct?

deployment_outcome_truth.question: What happened after the requested action in the complete deployed system?
deployment_outcome_truth.analysis: intention-to-treat; downstream failures remain charged to the deployed policy while mechanism blame is reported separately

semantic_suitability_before_marginal_val.purpose: supply learnable OFF examples without turning executor failure or invalid retrieval into PM gold

labels.DO_NOT_OPEN: independent candidate truth is VALID_REDUNDANT or VALID_NOT_USEFUL
labels.ABSTAIN: candidate truth is UNRESOLVED or reviewers disagree

semantic_suitability_before_marginal_val.marginal_value_scope: paired Q ON_ONLY/OFF_ONLY/EITHER is learned only inside OPEN_ELIGIBLE after FUNCTIONAL execution and risk SAFE
semantic_suitability_before_marginal_val.final_component_decision: DO_NOT_OPEN and ABSTAIN route OFF; OPEN_ELIGIBLE proceeds to the low-capacity marginal-value head; retrieval-invalid is charged upstream and excluded from PM supervision

functional_execution: a deterministic context-only M0 fallback is NOT_USED_FINAL for every ON-only candidate
if the rejected first-pass reply was not saved, raw execution and guard correctness are UNRESOLVED_RAW_MISSING
functional use requires a response-bound evidence excerpt and the exact candidate contribution, not topical overlap
wrong owner, wrong time, wrong event, scaffold exposure, or atomic-move violation cannot be FUNCTIONAL
surface repetition without changing the response act is SURFACE_ECHO_ONLY
generator self-report is telemetry, never gold
quality: Q is positive_support_contribution, not overall acceptability, risk, function, or cost
both arms are judged with the same verified-past panel and candidate context available for factual checking
Q judges do not receive F/R/C labels and do not decide candidate applicability
positive Q without independently qualified F remains deployment ITT and cannot become ON_ONLY gold
risk: record absolute events in both arms before resource attribution
wrong-owner, future, private-source fabrication, explicit-boundary violation, and excessive directiveness are distinct events
CANARY_UNQUALIFIED, missing, or disputed risk is UNRESOLVED, never SAFE
risk does not rewrite Q; it controls safe oracle eligibility
cost: cost never enters a component head label
deterministic incremental injected tokens are used only after safe Q equivalence in joint projection
provider input/output tokens, latency, fallback, and USD remain separate deployment outcomes

semantic_boundary.claim: The PM learns bounded deployment-visible distinctions, not unrestricted human semantics.
allowed_inputs: typed candidate text and metadata available at runtime
explicit low-dimensional redundancy, readiness, boundary, and action-result features
semantic_boundary.unknown_policy: out-of-support, reviewer-disputed, or representation-insufficient states are UNRESOLVED and force only that component bit OFF in learned_pm_qualified; transparent_rule remains a separate baseline and is never substituted for a failed or abstaining learned head
semantic_boundary.paper_assumption: candidate discovery and bounded semantic representation are measured modules with stated coverage; their errors are not silently charged to Step1

action_and_oracle.oracle_set: among structurally valid and risk-resolved actions, retain every action within 0.10 Q of the best, then retain the minimum deterministic injected-token frontier including exact ties
action_and_oracle.unresolved_rule: if candidate, execution, Q, or risk is unresolved, no oracle action is fabricated

responsibility_views.deployment_itt: the full policy is evaluated by its requested action and final response, including fallback
mechanism_blame_order: PM Step1 on a resolved oracle only
responsibility_views.pm_can_be_blamed_only_if: the candidate and opportunity oracle are resolved before action, and requested action is incompatible with that oracle
responsibility_views.executor_can_be_blamed_only_if: the PM request is oracle-compatible but the candidate is not correctly received and functionally realized
responsibility_views.resource_interaction_can_be_blamed_only_: candidate, PM, executor, guard, Q, and risk are all resolved and valid, but correct resource use still worsens the response

repair_sequence.required: all 576 groups and 1,728 replicates receive no-overwrite accountability rows; fallback F is deterministically repaired; original Q is retained only as deployment ITT
two independent outcome-blind reviewers label the same frozen 64-group packet before the private key is opened; disagreements are adjudicated without changing the rubric

candidate clear-applicability and F-qualified-vs-nonqualified each achieve raw agreement at least 0.80 and Cohen kappa at least 0.60; Q directional preference achieves raw agreement at least 0.70 and kappa at least 0.40
repair_sequence.failure_action: repair rubric/judge and run a new named calibration sample; do not relabel until a chosen threshold passes

repair_sequence.required: each learned head has resolved clean examples on both sides of the decision boundary across at least 12 independent clusters, with no single user or dialogue supplying more than 15 percent of effective weight

on user/dialogue-grouped nested cross-fitting, the predeclared low-capacity head improves OOF MSE by at least 5 percent over the fold-training mean and has OOF Spearman at least 0.15; sign and calibration diagnostics must not contradict the gain
repair_sequence.failure_action: the head is fixed OFF in learned_pm_qualified; transparent_rule remains a separate comparator; no outcome-driven feature or threshold revision

repair_sequence.required: only heads passing D and E enter the 16-action projector; nonpassing heads are fixed OFF; compare the resulting partial learned policy against all frozen baselines

role_decomposed_calibration_v2_required.sample: new outcome-hidden 64-group sample from unused formal groups; exclude the prior 32 and calibration-v1 64 groups
role_decomposed_calibration_v2_required.selection: 16 per component, maximum-coverage balanced before outcome by candidate subtype, cluster, fold, redundancy/readiness diagnostics, and expected open-like versus do-not-open-like strata; construction strata are never gold. If the unused natural pool cannot supply balance, freeze and report the deficit rather than fabricate or outcome-select rows
role_decomposed_calibration_v2_required.staged_execution: run two independent candidate-suitability reviewers first while the private outcome key remains closed; continue to function/quality/risk roles only if candidate agreement and resolved bidirectional support justify the additional review calls

independent_roles.candidate_suitability: sees current dialogue and candidate only; produces candidate truth and OPEN_ELIGIBLE/DO_NOT_OPEN/invalid/abstain projection
independent_roles.functional_execution: sees candidate and one ON reply only; uses component-specific function rules and exact evidence IDs; never sees OFF or preference
independent_roles.quality_preference: sees same verified-past panel plus blinded ON/OFF replies in randomized order; never sees candidate/function/risk labels
independent_roles.risk: records absolute events per arm before resource attribution; never sees quality preference

component_specific_function_minimums.MP: the profile, preference, or relationship fact changes personalization or response act; names/topic echoes alone fail
component_specific_function_minimums.MS: the response explicitly and accurately bridges a specific prior observation to the current state
component_specific_function_minimums.ME: the action-result evidence changes whether/how an action is proposed or avoided
component_specific_function_minimums.RS: the selected strategy card's atomic move is realized without extra competing move or burden

role_decomposed_calibration_v2_required.consensus_only_policy: only reviewer agreement or frozen central adjudication becomes resolved; all other rows remain UNRESOLVED

small_sample_capacity.outer_cross_fit: six user-grouped folds; aliases and shared source dialogues remain bound
small_sample_capacity.model_family: predeclared regularized linear or monotone low-capacity model; no neural fine-tuning and no outcome-selected feature search
small_sample_capacity.three_user_pilot: diagnostic only and forbidden for final representation selection
small_sample_capacity.claim: 18 users can support a narrow low-capacity cross-fitted feasibility result with cluster uncertainty; it cannot guarantee narrow confidence intervals or all-head success

minimum_success_claim.primary: the qualified partial learned PM provides measurable conditional benefit over always-off and is not inferior in response quality while improving risk or context cost relative to at least one nontrivial fixed/transparent comparator
minimum_success_claim.component_reporting: inside learned_pm_qualified, report each of MP/MS/ME/RS as learned-qualified or fixed-OFF; transparent_rule is a separate baseline only; do not require all four to pass in order to evaluate a scientifically valid partial policy
minimum_success_claim.cannot_be_guaranteed_by_contract: positive empirical effect on unseen clusters
minimum_success_claim.what_is_guaranteed: an unlearnable or invalidly measured head cannot silently enter the final learned policy

known_failures: 70 ON replicates fell back to M0 and 28 were nevertheless labeled USED
the frozen 32-group audit found 46 of 82 reviewable nonqualified uses labeled USED by the original judge
original Q sign and manual preference sign agreed on only 17 of 32 groups
only 7 of 32 audited groups jointly had a clearly applicable candidate, three reviewable replicates, at least two functional uses, and no boundary violation
all 576 formal groups have risk_instrument_status CANARY_UNQUALIFIED
the 576 natural states contain no controlled semantic high/low counterfactual family
the original memory pilot selected 5-6-dimensional heads from only two training users per held-out user
combined dual-reviewer calibration failed all candidate, function, and preference agreement gates and yielded only 20/64 provisionally fully labelable groups

allowed_now: new role-decomposed outcome-blind calibration on unused public groups
baseline and metric wiring without outcome tuning
